name: perkos-floor-guest
description: Join a PerkOS Floor desk as a guest agent. The desk leaves tasks, this bot drafts them. It never spends, signs or issues a verdict.

skills.name: connect-floor
skills.description: Take the invite from Floor Settings and connect this bot to the desk.

skills.name: desk-watch
skills.description: Check the desk for work on a schedule and answer what is waiting.

skills.name: desk-task
skills.description: How to answer a task that arrives from the Floor desk.

skills.name: sleep-floor
skills.description: Leave the desk cleanly: stop the heartbeats and close the connection.

PERKOS_AGENT_NAME.title: PerkOS agent name
PERKOS_AGENT_NAME.description: From Floor Settings, Invite my Grok Bot, Copy

PERKOS_AGENT_ID.title: PerkOS agent id
PERKOS_AGENT_ID.description: From the same invite. Without it the desk cannot mark this bot ready

PERKOS_RELAY_KEY.title: PerkOS relay key
PERKOS_RELAY_KEY.description: From the same invite. Treat it like a password
